A few notes/assumptions — please review and call out anything that doesn't match PatientStream's expected control posture:
- We use EU SCCs (new EU Commission Standard Contractual Clauses) for EU->US transfers and augment with AES-256 encrypted in-transit links, restricted key access (KMS), and strict role-based access controls.
- For inference-only requests where hashed/pseudonymized tokens are sent and no long-term storage occurs, we recommend a DPA clause that permits transient processing under controller instructions.
- We can provide a signed annex and SSO-configured audit logs if you onboard to a Dedicated deployment.

If you want us to push a redlined DPA with PatientStream's changes (we can accept tracked changes), indicate the legal contact and we'll prepare.

Anna — quick answers inline to help your committee prep: 

> 1) SCCs vs DPF: We support SCCs as the default transfer mechanism. For customers who demonstrate a DPF or equivalent transfer certification, we can accept incorporated attestation language (we have a standard addendum flow). In short: SCCs by default; DPF attestation + contractual language accepted on a case-by-case basis and logged in our compliance register.

> 2) Subprocessors: Attached is the requested CSV with domain names; marked confidential. See file: subprocessor_list_20280403.csv (uploaded to Drive, restricted view).

> 3) Retention windows:
> - Transient inference (no storage): raw input retained for up to 24 hours in ephemeral KV caches, auto-purged; outputs are not persisted.
> - Short-term storage (customer-configured): default 30 days unless customer sets longer; retention changes are documented in the DPA annex under Section 5.
> - Dedicated/on-prem: retention is customer-configurable and controlled by the customer's tenancy settings; Redwood does not access customer-stored artifacts without lawful request.

We've also uploaded an annotated DPA annex: redwood-dpa-annex-draft-v1.docx with tracked-change callouts for Hosted vs Dedicated. Link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPSR-DPF

If the committee needs a short (15 min) walkthrough of the evidence pack we can schedule a slot tomorrow morning US time.

— Jonas
